papers.title: YOLOv8-based Intelligent Robotic Harvesting Platform With a Custom 6-DOF Manipulator
papers.summary: This study proposes a 6-degree-of-freedom (DOF) active re-observation method for detecting strawberry disease symptoms hidden from a single front view. The experimental evaluation was conducted using 50 mock strawberries, which were reused across 10 randomized trials. After grasping a fruit, the manipulator reorients it toward a red, green, blue plus depth (RGB-D) camera for backside inspection, supported by the small-sized You Only Look Once version 8 segmentation model, 18-layer residual network, RGB-D localization, and principal component analysis (PCA)-based roll estimation. papers.title: Design Space Exploration of Reinforcement Learning Configurations for Post-Legalization Placement
papers.summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) have recently been explored for VLSI placement optimization, but their effectiveness for post-legalization placement refinement remains unclear. This paper presents a systematic design space exploration of a GNN-Proximal Policy Optimization (GNN-PPO) framework across three ISPD2015 benchmarks. We evaluate 18 configurations covering reward functions, GNN architectures, action spaces, candidate-set sizes, and training strategies. papers.title: An Integrated XAI-RL Architecture for Ethical Decision-Making in Autonomous Robots
papers.summary: Can a robot's ethical reasoning be transparent without slowing it down? That is the question we set out to answer. papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Optimized Well Placement in Underground Hydrogen Storage
papers.summary: Abstract Well placement design for underground hydrogen storage (UHS) faces the challenge of balancing hydrogen recovery, costs, and operational constraints. This study develops a rule-guided reinforcement learning (RL) framework to jointly optimize well count and well locations for a depleted gas reservoir in Alberta, Canada. The objective is long-term net present value (NPV), which is normalized as total reward. papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a fundamental framework for addressing sequential decision problems under uncertainty about system dynamics and outcomes. While RL has made significant progress in recent decades, deploying these methods in real-world scenarios remains challenging. A major obstacle is that standard RL algorithms typically assume the absence of unmeasured confounders—an assumption that is often unverifiable and frequently violated in practice, particularly in medical and human behavior domains. papers.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning (RAR) mitigates the static knowledge limitations of Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating external evidence acquisition into reasoning. Recent work has introduced reinforcement learning (RL) to optimize retrieval jointly with reasoning. However, many RL-based RAR methods still organize retrieval reactively, where search is triggered by local uncertainty or immediate evidence gaps. papers.title: When Optimization Forgets the Minority: Bias Amplification in Policy-Gradient Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Bias amplification, the tendency of trained models to be more biased than the data that produced them, is well documented in supervised learning. We study it in policy-gradient reinforcement learning, where there is no static dataset: each episode belongs to a latent group that shapes the reward but is invisible to the policy. papers.summary: This dataset contains road survey video recordings collected within the CAMBER - European Road Infrastructure Monitoring Project. The videos capture forward-facing visual information on road infrastructure condition, including pavement defects, surface degradation, and road furniture elements. **Data Generation Method:** The video was recorded using mobile devices during road monitoring campaigns. papers.title: System design of the Ultra Mobility Vehicle: A driving, balancing, and jumping bicycle robot
papers.summary: Trials cyclists and mountain bike riders can hop, jump, balance, and drive on one or both wheels. This versatility allows them to achieve speed and energy efficiency on smooth terrain and agility over rough terrain. Inspired by these athletes, we present the design and control of a robotic platform, Ultra Mobility Vehicle (UMV), that combines a bicycle and a reaction mass to move dynamically with minimal actuated degrees of freedom. papers.title: FoMo: A multi-season dataset for robot navigation in Forêt Montmorency
papers.summary: The Forêt Montmorency (FoMo) dataset is a comprehensive multi-season data collection, recorded over the span of 1 year in a boreal forest. Featuring a unique combination of on- and off-pavement environments with significant environmental changes, the dataset challenges established odometry and SLAM pipelines. Some highlights of the data include the accumulation of snow exceeding 1 m, significant vegetation growth in front of sensors, and operations at the traction limits of the platform. papers.title: Safety and Short-Term Clinical Outcomes of Robot-Assisted Lobectomy Based on the Tubeless Concept for Early-Stage Lung Cancer: A Retrospective Cohort Study
papers.summary: AIM: The Tubeless comprehensive management model minimizes iatrogenic trauma by avoiding endotracheal intubation, chest tube placement, and urinary catheterization, while the robot-assisted thoracoscopic surgery system offers precise surgical manipulation and high-definition visualization. However, clinical evidence supporting the combination of these two approaches in early-stage lung cancer surgery remains limited. This study aimed to evaluate the short-term safety and clinical benefits of robot-assisted lobectomy based on the Tubeless concept in patients with early-stage lung cancer.METHODS

papers.title: Force-based Real-time Inhomogeneity Detection for Robotic Uniform Mixing of Heterogeneous Materials
papers.summary: This study proposes a time-series learning approach for the real-time detection of inhomogeneity (clumping) in heterogeneous materials during robotic mixing using force-torque sensor data. Many existing robotic mixing systems execute predefined motion patterns that do not fully leverage dynamic changes in material states, resulting in limited responsiveness to transient mixing conditions. To better capture these dynamic variations, time-series force and torque data collected from a 6-axis sensor mounted on a robot arm are segmented into fixed-length temporal windows and used as model inputs. papers.summary: Search and Rescue (SAR) robotics increasingly depends on collaborative intelligence to operate effectively in dynamic, uncertain, and time-sensitive environments. Modern SAR missions require coordinated interaction among heterogeneous robotic agents as well as structured collaboration between humans and intelligent systems for perception, decision-making, and adaptive mission execution. OTTP: A Benchmark Protocol for Trajectory-Prefix Risk Prediction in Offline Safe Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: OTTP provides a reproducible protocol and benchmark for hindsight-defined trajectory-prefix cumulative-cost prediction on offline safe-RL logs. The primary endpoint is Step catastrophic AUPRC. The archive contains code, result tables, run records, and split and preprocessing artifacts.

papers.title: Learning to Generalize Across Conditions: A PPO-Based Learning Approach to Multi-Condition Multi-Objective Optimization
papers.summary: This study introduces sPPO-CR, a policy-gradient deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithm for multi-objective (MO) and multi-condition multi-objective (MCMO) optimization. papers.title: Design and Flight Validation of Monocular-vision-based Relative Altitude Estimation for Precision Landing of Lightweight Aerial Vehicles
papers.summary: Monocular-vision-based precision landing is promising for small unmanned aerial vehicles operating under strict payload constraints. However, detection noise and image disturbances can degrade altitude estimation accuracy and destabilize terminal landing performance. This study presents a vision-based precision landing framework that integrates a calibrated area - altitude model with an extended Kalman filter (EKF) to improve relative altitude estimation and landing accuracy. papers.summary: Abstract Uncontrolled liquid spills in upstream and midstream facilities represent a significant threat to safety, operational profitability and environmental compliance. papers.title: A Systematic Review of EEG-Based Visual Decoding Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning
papers.summary: The primary objective of this research is to develop and validate robust computational frameworks capable of decoding complex cognitive processes—specifically visual perception and mental imagery—directly from non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG) signals. papers.summary: Research code and supporting processed data accompanying the study "Analysis of pig appeasing pheromone effects on social behaviour and welfare in group-housed sows using computer vision".
